frail.definition:
n. the weight of a frail (basket) full of raisins or figs; between 50 and 75 pounds
n. a basket for holding dried fruit (especially raisins or figs)
a. physically weak
frail.translation:
a. 脆弱的, 虚弱的, 意志薄弱的
n. 少女, 少妇, 灯心草篓

frailer.definition:
a. physically weak
s. wanting in moral strength, courage, or will; having the attributes of man as opposed to e.g. divine beings
s. easily broken or damaged or destroyed
frailer.translation: a. 脆弱的( frail的比较级 ); 易损的; 易碎的

frailest.definition:
a. physically weak
s. wanting in moral strength, courage, or will; having the attributes of man as opposed to e.g. divine beings
s. easily broken or damaged or destroyed
frailest.translation: a. 脆弱的( frail的最高级 ); 易损的; 易碎的

frailly.translation: adv. 脆弱地, 不坚实地

frails.definition:
plural of frail
n. the weight of a frail (basket) full of raisins or figs; between 50 and 75 pounds
n. a basket for holding dried fruit (especially raisins or figs)
a. physically weak
frails.translation:
(frail 的复数) a. 脆弱的, 虚弱的, 意志薄弱的
n. 少女, 少妇, 灯心草篓

frailties.translation: n. 脆弱( frailty的名词复数 ); 虚弱; （性格或行为上的）弱点; 缺点

frailty.translation:
n. 弱点, 脆弱, 意志薄弱
[法] 虚弱, 意志薄弱, 因意志薄弱而犯的错误

frain.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 费雷恩地貌名称，来源于古法语，含义是“梣”(ash)

fraise.definition:
n. a ruff for the neck worn in the 16th century
n. sloping or horizontal rampart of pointed stakes
fraise.translation:
n. 障碍物
[医] 爪棱钻

fraised.translation: n. (16世纪欧洲人戴的)绉领, 高领；【军事】铁丝网(或木桩)构成的障碍物, 寨栅
